title: Majlis 6 | Ahle Bait (a.s.) Par Zulm Karne Aur Unki Nusrat Na Karne Ka Azaab | Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi
excerpt: This lecture by Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi explores the profound spiritual and theological consequences of opposing or failing to support the Ahlulbayt (a.s.). The discourse emphasizes that true love for the Prophet's family requires active allegiance and that enmity toward them is equivalent to declaring war against Allah. Through historical references, scholarly methodology, and the tragic narratives of Ashura, the speaker highlights the necessity of following the true Imam and the dangers of worldly distractions that hinder religious devotion.
content:
Ali Akbar, keep looking back at me as you go. Oh, the news of the sick one in Medina must be coming. You are taking my eyesight along with you. How will I read the letter, how will I read the letter, Sugra, Ali Akbar? Keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. It will be difficult for me to come, my son. Oh, do not go far away in the battlefield, my son. Oh, I cannot even walk anymore, Ali Akbar. Keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. If my grandfather asks where you were delayed, tell him that permission was obtained with great difficulty. Come and embrace me again, Ali Akbar. Keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. When Nana (the Prophet) passed away, old age had come upon Amma (Zainab). Oh, you are leaving, it is a trial, Ali's likeness is meeting, Zainab is becoming old, Ali Akbar, keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. And oh my dear son, I entrust you to your father, those with spears are standing and laughing on the battlefield. Let me look at you well again, let me look at your chest well again, Ali Akbar, keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. And after beating his head, the Master (Imam Hussain) gave this consolation, 'My Zainab's veil is the witness to my poverty.' Oh, I cannot give you a shroud, Ali Akbar, keep looking back at me as you go, Ali Akbar. May Allah have mercy on those who recite Al-Fatiha. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Disposer of affairs, the best Master and the best Helper. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and the end is for the pious and the certain. And blessings and peace be upon the noblest of prophets and messengers, the beloved of the Lord of the worlds, Abul Qasim Muhammad. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. May Allah bless him and his infallible family, those from whom Allah has removed all impurity and purified them with a thorough purification. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. Especially the Remnant of Allah on earth, our Imam of the Time, the Master of our affair, our Owner, our Master, our Beloved, our Physician, our Companion, and... The Master of peace, the Helper of the distressed, the Straight Path, the soul of the worlds, may he be ransomed. Thereafter, Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has said: 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast.' (Quran 33:4). The truth of Allah, the Most High, the Almighty, and the truth of the Noble Messenger, amen, O Lord of the worlds. Salawat: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. God Almighty says in verse number four of Surah Al-Ahzab that 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast'; there is only one heart. And the interpretation of this noble verse has been presented to you, which means that if there is love for the People of Truth in the heart, then there cannot be love for the People of Falsehood. Wilayah and Bara'ah was the topic, and continuing this series, today we move towards another sub-topic, that is, the side-topic, titled—briefly, two hadiths in this regard—that we who love and have affection for the Ahlulbayt (a.s.), we do so for the sake of Allah's command and for the sake of the Prophet's (s.a.w.a.) honor. It is Allah's command that Allah Almighty says in the Holy Quran, 'O Prophet, say to them: I do not ask of you any reward for it except love for the near of kin.' Whatever hardships I have endured for this Prophethood, to deliver this message, to send this mission, whatever hardships I have endured, I do not want any reward from you—meaning no worldly wealth, no worldly status, no position, no rank, nothing of the world—I only ask for one thing from you, and that is to love my Ahlulbayt. 'I do not ask of you any reward for it except love for the near of kin.' That is it, I do not want anything else. Love my Ahlulbayt. And what was the background of this? The background was such that the Prophet (s.a.w.a.)—O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad—is coming to the mosque, the mosque is bustling. The mosque is bustling with Muslims. The noble companions are all present. The Prophet came and asked, 'O people! How did you find me as a Prophet?' They said, 'The best Prophet, O Messenger of Allah.' 'How did you find me as a Messenger?' They said, 'The best Messenger, O Messenger of Allah.' The best Prophet, the best Messenger. 'O people! Tell me, did I show any negligence in delivering the message?' Everyone said, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' 'O people! Tell me, have I asked you for anything to this day for these efforts, for these hardships?' This is the essence of the narration. Everyone said, 'No, O Messenger of Allah, you have not asked for anything.' 'Today I am asking.' So the phrase found in history and tradition is that people bowed their heads. Think, today the Messenger of Allah, who had not asked for anything until now, is now asking for everything—that your land, your property, this, that, whatever it is, write it all in my name. Transfer all your property, as much as possible. The Prophet said, 'Ayyuhan-nas! Irfa'u ru'usakum.' O people! Raise your heads. 'Irfa'u ru'usakum.' Raise your heads. People raised their heads. 'I do not ask you for anything, I do not want anything of the world.' 'Except love for my family, my near ones, love my progeny, and I do not ask for anything else from you.' Now, how people distorted all these things, what happened in the books, that is not the topic right now, God willing, there will be a discussion on that sometime later. God willing, if Allah grants the opportunity. Anyway, so this respect we show, this love we have for the Ahlulbayt, is based on Allah's command and the Prophet's (s.a.w.a.) honor. Allama Majlisi (may Allah have mercy on him)—let me tell you about Allama Majlisi, let me present a point to you—that when Allama Majlisi was writing 'Bihar', he included a chapter in 'Bihar al-Anwar'. God willing, if Allah grants the opportunity, we will discuss that chapter. 'The Chapter on the Etiquette of Narration.' Meaning, what is the etiquette of narrating a tradition? Meaning, there is an etiquette to it, there is a method to it, there is a decorum to it. That is why the scholars did not give permission until a person narrated the tradition in front of them. This is what is called Hadith, in the science of Hadith it is called 'Ar-Riwayah 'ala al-Qira'ah 'ala al-Mashikha'. Meaning, reading the Hadith in front of the Sheikh, meaning the teacher, or sometimes the teacher who taught the Hadith would read it, and the student who was learning would check it; that was called 'As-Sama'u minhu'. Meaning, having heard it from him and then checked it. Then he would give permission that he could narrate this Hadith. Anyway, in this chapter, Allama Majlisi has brought a point in 'Adab al-Riwayah' that not everyone is allowed to narrate a tradition, but if there is even a slight suspicion, if a person is certain in his opinion that this Hadith is forged, this Hadith is not correct, then if he narrated the Hadith knowing this, 'Fahuwa ahad al-kadhibin'—he becomes one of the liars who narrated that Hadith knowing it was false. One narration is about that. And then after that, there is a verse from the Holy Quran in which Allah says—recite a Salawat on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. 'Give good tidings to My servants who listen to the word and follow the best of it.' In the interpretation of this verse, the Imam says, 'Al-Qawl' refers to our Hadiths, and following the best of it means that just as you hear it, narrate it in the same way. Do not add a single letter to it, nor subtract a single letter from it. Do not add an alphabet to it, nor deduct an alphabet from it. Exactly as you heard it. This is etiquette. These are all the etiquettes of narration that Allama Majlisi (may Allah have mercy on him) has brought. And if you read the Hadiths of this chapter yourself, you will realize how much Allama Majlisi himself took care, how much he was aware of this. Those who say that he collected pebbles and pearls, these people are slandering Allama Majlisi. They are talking without thinking, and these are the ones who have not read the preface of 'Bihar'. Let alone the whole 'Bihar'. If they had at least read the preface, they would not say such things, never. These are the individuals who have not even seen the preface of 'Bihar'. Nowhere in the preface did Allama Majlisi say that I have collected pebbles and pearls. Because the title he gave to 'Bihar' itself shows that this is not the topic at all. Meaning, this method, this approach is not Allama Majlisi's at all. Because the name of the book, 'Bihar al-Anwar, Jami' al-Durar-e-Jami' al-Durar-e-Akhbar-e-Aal-e-Athar' or something like that. Meaning, Jami', this book 'Bihar al-Anwar' is a collection, meaning it has collected. Jami' means collected, and Durar means pearls, precious stones. The name of the book tells you that precious stones—meaning if you... and Bahr al-Anwar itself means Bahr (oceans) and Anwar (lights), and Jami' (collection). So it is clear that those who dive—you must have seen them diving in the sea to extract pearls—they extract pearls from the collection, or whatever trash is lying inside, they bring it up. They say, 'Brother, our job is just to bring all the trash and everything, our job is to collect.' Have you ever heard this from him? Never. So this is a slander against Allama Majlisi. Anyway, I stated this so that you know how many favors he has upon us and how easily people reject it, just as if it is nothing. Anyway, Allama Majlisi has brought a chapter in this ocean titled 'What is required from preserving the honor of the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) regarding them', meaning regarding the Ahlulbayt (a.s.), meaning the honor of the Ahlulbayt in the honor of the Prophet. Why are we honoring the Ahlulbayt? For the honor of the Prophet. And 'Iqabu'—or if you want to call it the punishment—'Iqabe man qatala-hum wa jalama-hum wa khadhala-hum wa lam yansur-hum.' Allahu Akbar. And what will be the punishment for the person who fought against the Ahl al-Bayt? 'Qatala-hum' means to wage war. What will be his punishment? 'Wa jalama-hum'—those who oppressed the Ahl al-Bayt. Now, look, there are degrees of oppression; we do not need to go into the details of that right now. But there are degrees of oppression. Sometimes we think oppression means only a great tyrant who has committed massive atrocities, but that is not the case. Sometimes we ourselves are doing wrong by making our Imam-e-Zamana (a.s.) weep. We also make our Imam-e-Zamana weep through our actions. We make our Imam of the time weep through our sins and our disobedience. The Imam-e-Zamana laments; the traditions exist. And is the grief of the Sayyid al-Shuhada (a.s.) not enough for the Imam-e-Zamana? The Imam-e-Zamana says, 'Fala-udubanna 'alayka sabahan wa masa'an wa la-abkiyanna 'alayka badal-ad-dumu'i dama'—Morning and evening I weep for you, and in place of tears, I shed blood.' And remember, the Imam does not use exaggeration. Do you know there is a tradition from the sixth Imam (a.s.)? There is a tradition from the sixth Imam that while weeping for the Sayyid al-Shuhada, he says, 'Your grief has wounded our eyelids.' And because of this wound, blood is flowing from them. Is it clear to you? The Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) and the Ahl al-Bayt—Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa Aali Muhammad—mean that their thought, their remembrance, every moment, every instant, that God forbid, are we not falling short in their rights? 'Wa khadhala-hum'—or those who abandoned them. They abandoned the Ahl al-Bayt. They don't even attend the Majlis. They are not fulfilling the right of Azadari—though one can never truly fulfill that right, but they are not doing it as it should be done. 'What should I do? There are these issues, problems, business, etc.' A thousand excuses. Look, the one who has an excuse finds it very easily. Just like Ubaidullah Ju'fi had an excuse. He was a companion of the Mawla-e-Kainat (a.s.), he used to stay with him, everything was there. But Allah gave him wealth. When he got wealth, his mind got corrupted and he went out of his senses. The Sayyid al-Shuhada (a.s.) asked, 'Will you come to help me?' He said, 'Take my horse, take my wealth, take all of that. I will help you financially in this way. But I cannot come because my business is very spread out.' This is the same man who used to sit with complete humility and devotion in front of Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.) because at that time he did not have that much wealth. Now that he has wealth, he is giving this answer to the Sayyid al-Shuhada before Karbala. And in contrast to him is Janab-e-Zuhayr, who even left his wife. He divorced her, saying, 'I have divorced you.' But, of course, his wife did not agree. She said, 'No, no, I will go with you, I will go with you.' And she took him along to Karbala. Not into the tents of the Sayyid al-Shuhada, but regardless, abandoning them completely. Look, today's 'Nusrat' (help) is of a different kind. The help at that time was of a different kind. When the Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) arrives, the help will be different. Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa Aali Muhammad. So, Allama Majlisi writes, 'Khadhala-hum wa lam yansur-hum'—those who abandon them and do not help them. What to do? There is no time. And parents have a very big role in this. Look, there is a point: parents stop their children from, for example, religious education. Why? 'Oh, he has his tenth-grade exam now. Oh, he has his eleventh-grade exam now. Oh, he has his twelfth-grade exam now. Oh, he has to do UPSC.' The actual time for acquiring knowledge is when they stop them. And naturally, what happens is that when they move from adolescence to youth, everything slips out of their hands. Now their interest is gone. Parents stop them, and other people stop them too. There are many people in society who do not like children to be 'Deendar' (religious). 'What if they stand up tomorrow and start questioning us? Then what will we do?' Everyone is concerned about themselves. That is why they don't even want it. There are many such people. Just like you must have seen in politics, the politician—the bad politician, not the good one, because there are two types of politicians: one good and one bad. So, the bad politician wants his entire nation to remain ignorant so that they keep voting for him. If the nation becomes educated, it will raise questions on everything. It will question different things. If the nation becomes educated... Similarly, there are many people who do not like it if children become religious and educated, if they acquire religious knowledge, they will ask questions about everything. Then who will answer? So, there are many such obstacles. And they say, 'No, don't teach them, don't let them write, let it be as it is.' And the result is that children become distant from the religion. When they become distant from the religion, they become distant from their Imam of the time. When they become distant from the Imam of the time, then naturally, whom will you blame? Whom will you blame? What is surprising if the children forgot the house, while the elders forgot the religion of God? excerpt: This lecture addresses common misconceptions regarding the occultation (Ghaibat) of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.), clarifying that he is not physically isolated in a remote location. Drawing from Hadith and Quranic examples like Prophet Musa (a.s.), the speaker explains that the Imam lives among people, though they may not recognize him. The session emphasizes that the Imam remains aware of our conditions and that the 'hidden' nature of the Imam is a divine tradition consistent with previous prophets.
content:
Yes, tell me, yes, Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, Sallallahu Alaika Ya... Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Regarding the grave of Imam Ali (a.s.), there are many wrong perspectives, and among them is one that Imam-e-Zamana (a.s.) is currently in some desert, on some mountain, or in some place, and does not meet anyone. No one can meet him, no one can see him, and the Imam is unaware of our conditions. No, this is absolutely not the case. If we look at it in the light of the Quran and Hadith, what is it? And what is the meeting with Imam Hasan (a.s.)? Imam Sadiq (a.s.) says in a Hadith regarding Imam Hasan (a.s.), 'They will see him, but will not recognize him.' Look how easily the son of Mushkil Kusha (the remover of difficulties) has made our difficulty easy. He says, 'People will see the Imam, but will not recognize him.' We meet thousands of people every day, we deal with them, but we do not recognize some of them. So it is very possible that we have met the Imam (a.s.) and did not recognize him. Imam Sadiq (a.s.) said to one of his companions named Abdul Hamid... A companion named Abdul Hamid, he said, 'Abdul Hamid, some of the Imams were manifest, and some were hidden. Now it is necessary that you pray through the mediation of these Imams who were manifest, and also through those who were hidden.' After this, the Imam (a.s.) recited verse number 78 of Surah Ghafir. He says, 'And We have sent messengers before you, of some of whom We have told you, and of some We have not told you.' If we ponder over this verse and the recitation we have obtained, some things become clear. Firstly, there are many such Imams who were hidden, who did not manifest themselves in the world. Secondly, this is the Sunnah of Allah that He kept some of His proofs hidden. And thirdly, these Imams were the same ones who were manifest. But they were Imams, and they performed their duties well. These Imams did not seclude themselves; rather, they were among the people. They did not declare any desert, any wilderness, or any mountain as their residence. Let us make the matter easier. Let us take the example of Musa (a.s.). He grew up in the palace of Pharaoh and was raised there, but Pharaoh did not know that he was a Prophet. And Musa (a.s.) also did not know when he would become the cause of his destruction. title: Ep#17 | Kya Ab Tak 313 Ashaab Nahin Huey?
excerpt: This lecture addresses the common question of why the 313 companions of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) have not yet gathered. The speaker clarifies the distinction between a sign of reappearance and a necessary condition, emphasizing that the reappearance is ultimately dependent on the command of Allah. By referencing Quranic verses and narrations, the talk explains that Allah has the power to gather the companions instantly when the time is right.
content:
Yes brother, keep it, dear background, give me permission. Peace be upon you, viewers. As you know, this is our series, and regarding the questions related to the Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.), people have raised objections about the Imam's age, the Imam's occultation, and the Imam's companions. And our effort is to provide you with the answers to all those questions. So let us move towards the question of our episode: Are 313 companions not gathering yet? If there is talk of 313 companions gathering, then this is a very... It is a very important question because there is a difference between a sign and a condition. As for the gathering of 313 companions, let us look at the Quran. In verse 148 of Surah Baqarah, it says, 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, wherever you are, Allah will gather you.' Now, if we look at the commentary of this verse, we will find a narration of Imam Rida (a.s.) in which the Imam says, 'By Allah, when our Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) rises...' The Imam has used the word 'gathering' for the place of the Mahdi, which after hearing, a believer would want to stand up. 'By Allah, when our Mahdi rises, Allah will gather all the people from all cities around him.' When our Mahdi rises, Allah will gather all the people from all cities around him. So after looking at this Quranic verse and its commentary, we at least learned this much, this became known, that if Allah wants, He can gather anyone, anywhere, at any time. As for the question of the 313 companions, will the reappearance happen only after the completion of the 313 companions? The answer is no. Let us understand this clearly with an example. The presence of black clouds is one of the signs of rain, but the presence of black clouds in the sky is not a sign of the occurrence of rain. We have witnessed many times that black clouds cover the sky, but it does not rain. And we have also seen that there is no sign of black clouds in the sky, and it is raining. This means that rain is not dependent on black clouds. This means that rain is not dependent on black clouds. Rain is not dependent on that sign, but rather on the command of Allah. In exactly the same way, the completion of the 313 companions is one of the signs of the reappearance of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.), but this does not mean at all that if 313 companions gather, the reappearance will happen, and it also does not mean that if 313 companions are not there, the reappearance will not happen. The reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) is by the command of Allah. He will complete the 313 companions, and if you talk about the completion of the 313 companions, then what is not in the power of Allah? Allah can gather 313 companions whenever and wherever He wants, just as our Prophet Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (s.a.w.a.) says, 'If only one day of the world remains, Allah will make that day so long that He will bring forth from my progeny one who will fill the world with justice and equity, just as it was filled with oppression and tyranny.' This is like a body filled with gold; if one has trust in the Almighty, then no action is outside the power of Allah. Now, two points will be clarified here: first, whether the entire 313 companions of the Imam (a.s.) will be completed or not. If it is the will of the Almighty, the Imam's (a.s.) mission will begin. Second, if you consider the number 313 to be so important, then what is impossible for Allah? Whenever and in whatever state He wishes, Allah can complete the help of the 313 companions. He is the Provider... On the comment section or the description of this video, click there to provide the correct answer to the question. Those who provide the correct answer will be selected, and they will be given 1000 Indian Rupees as a reward. This will be the procedure.

title: Arbaeen Ka Pasmanzar - Baraahe Raast Karbala Se
excerpt: This lecture explores the profound significance of Arbaeen, the fortieth day following the martyrdom of Imam Hussain (a.s.). It highlights the historical events surrounding the return of the Ahlulbayt to Karbala, including the dream of Yazid's wife and the arrival of Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari. The speaker emphasizes the spiritual importance of Arbaeen as a sign of a believer and reflects on the enduring global devotion to Imam Hussain.
content:
It is clearly stated that this is a phenomenon of humanity that leaves the world in awe to this day. How is it possible that millions of people, out of love for one person, leave all their worldly affairs behind to gather on the land of Karbala to commemorate his martyrdom? This year, when the world is suffering from the spread of the coronavirus, the grief for Imam Hussain (a.s.) in these hearts is far greater than the fear of the virus. It is the grace of the Almighty and the blessing of the last proof, Hazrat Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.), that even in this atmosphere of fear, we were granted the opportunity to come to Karbala for Arbaeen. Imam Hussain (a.s.) proved by sacrificing his own life, his children, his companions, and his relatives that when there is a confrontation between truth and falsehood, the winner is not the one who kills his enemies, but the winner is only the one who is on the side of truth, even if he becomes a martyr. Even if he becomes a martyr. And Arbaeen is the fortieth day of the martyrdom of Imam Hussain (a.s.), but there is another aspect that is very important for us to know. When the Yazidi army had the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) of Imam Hussain (a.s.) taken to the palace in Damascus, one night the wife of Yazid saw a dream. She narrates: 'I saw a door of the sky open, and angels descended and gathered near the head of Imam Hussain (a.s.), saying, "Peace be upon you, O oppressed one; peace be upon you, O martyr." And then I saw a cloud descend from the sky in which many people were present. Among them was a man whose face was shining like the full moon. That person came near the blessed head of Imam Hussain (a.s.) and began to kiss his lips, saying, "My son, they killed you; they saw you, but they did not recognize you, and they even blocked water from you. My son, I am your grandfather, the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.). This is your father, Ali al-Murtaza; this is your brother, Hasan; and look, this is your..." ...brother Hasan, and look, this is your uncle Jafar and Aqeel. This is Hamza.' And then, one by one, he pointed towards every person from the family of Imam Hussain (a.s.). She says that I woke up in a state of shock, and when I saw that there was light everywhere around the head of Hussain (a.s.), I immediately called Yazid. At that time, Yazid was hitting his head against the wall in a dark room, saying, 'Woe to me, what did I have to do with Hussain?' He was possessed by guilt. I narrated my dream to him, and upon hearing it, Yazid said, 'I will release the family of the Messenger tomorrow morning.' The next day, he sent word that if they wished, they could stay here in my palace or return to Medina. We said that first, we will mourn for Hussain. So, a house was emptied for them in Damascus where they mourned for Imam Hussain (a.s.) for seven days. The tradition states that every woman from the Bani Hashim and the Quraish wore black clothes. Seven days later, Lady Zainab (s.a.) decided that she would first go to the grave of her brother Imam Hussain (a.s.) and then go to Medina. So, the caravan departed from Damascus, and the day it reached Karbala, it was... ...the day of Arbaeen. And the second characteristic related to Arbaeen is that when this caravan reached Karbala on Arbaeen, the companion of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.), Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, had come there with the help of his companions to perform the Ziyarat of Imam Hussain (a.s.). Thus, on the occasion of Arbaeen, Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari was the first to perform the Ziyarat of Imam Hussain (a.s.). And the third characteristic found regarding Arbaeen is that when Yazid released the family from Damascus, he returned all the belongings that the army had looted in Karbala, and along with that, he returned the blessed head of Imam Hussain (a.s.). They brought it back with all due respect, and it was the day of Arbaeen when the blessed head was reunited with the body of Imam Hussain (a.s.). In the end, regarding Arbaeen, our 11th Imam, Hazrat Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s.), says that there are five signs of a believer: praying fifty-one rak'ahs of prayer daily, observing the Ziyarat of Arbaeen, wearing a ring on the right hand, performing prostration on soil (turbah), and reciting Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim aloud in prayer. Seeing this gathering present in Karbala today, it is clear how much Allah values Imam Hussain (a.s.), and thank God that He granted us the opportunity to be present in Karbala on Arbaeen to commemorate this grief. On behalf of all of you, we pray to the Almighty from the holy land of Karbala that may Allah grant a swift reappearance to the Imam of the time, Hazrat Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.), the avenger of the blood of Hussain (a.s.), and may He grant us the day when the Imam of the time (a.s.) is present on the pulpit, narrating the tragedies of Imam Hussain (a.s.), and we can all join him in this mourning. Ameen, Ya Rabbal Alameen.

title: Shab e Qadr aur Wilayat e Ahle Bait (a.s.)  |  Dua Abu Hamza al-Thumali (r.a.) | Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi
excerpt: This lecture by Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi explores the profound spiritual significance of Shab-e-Qadr and its intrinsic connection to the Wilayah of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.). The discussion highlights how the divine decrees for the year are finalized by the Imam of the time on this blessed night, emphasizing the importance of spiritual renewal and seeking the Imam's reappearance. Furthermore, the session provides an in-depth introduction to the wisdom contained within Dua Abu Hamza al-Thumali, illustrating it as a vital tool for seeking divine mercy and strengthening one's commitment to the path of the Prophet.
content:
La ilaha illallah, and the choked throat... [Music] Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. O Allah, do not open... [Recitation of Dua] O Allah, fast... [Recitation of Dua]. Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. First of all, a million thanks to the Almighty that He kept us alive until this Night of Power (Shab-e-Qadr) so that we could benefit from these blessed days and nights and appear before Him with all our past sins, seeking forgiveness and repentance. Especially, He kept us alive in this blessed month of Ramadan so that we could pray for the reappearance of His Wali, His last proof, Hazrat Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.). This Night of Power is a night of prayers, a night of supplication, a night of voices, a night of worship, and most importantly, it is a night of the Imam of the time. As we see in the traditions, we often read that on this 23rd night, the angels descend to the Imam of the time with the decrees for the whole year, and the Imam puts his seal on them. The decision for the day and night is made on this very night. So why shouldn't we think about initiating a discussion that includes the Wilayah of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) and some discussions related to the Imam of the time? Just briefly, so that through it, we can discuss the hadiths of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) and revive their command, their Wilayah, and their remembrance, just as Hazrat Imam... So that our knowledge can be revived, as Imam Ali al-Ridha (a.s.) stated: 'May Allah have mercy on the person who revives our knowledge.' Someone asked, 'O Mawla, how is your knowledge revived?' The Imam replied, 'By learning our knowledge and teaching it to the people, because if people become aware of the beauty of our speech, they will follow us automatically.' It is under this objective that this program has been organized, which will include a speech, and God willing, after the speech, there will be the recitation of the Holy Quran. Therefore, I request the respected Dr. Abishab to come forward and shed light on the topic of 'The Status of Wilayah in Islam.' I request you all to welcome him with a loud Salawat. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Tonight is an excellent night. Insha'Allah, our scholars are present here. Let us understand its importance and the Wilayah of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.). First, keep in mind that this is a night of deeds, a night of worship. As much as possible, spend it in worship. God forbid, do not waste your time on useless things, as that is not appropriate at all. This night is very beneficial for you. Allah (s.w.t.) has said, 'Laylatul Qadri khairum min alfi shahr' (The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months). If you compare this night to others, it is incomparable. It is not just equal to others; it is better than a thousand months. If you perform worship on this night, it is better than a thousand months. If you perform worship for a thousand months, which is about 83 years, and you spend this night in worship, it is equivalent to that. You should not think that you are just doing it for one night; rather, the target is that this one night is better than a thousand months. If you perform worship, the reward is equivalent to a thousand months. If we recite the Quran throughout the month, understand the reward of the prayers performed on this night. Regarding the prayers, the Imam (a.s.) said, 'Whoever performs this prayer in this manner, until he remains in his place, the angels continue to seek forgiveness for him.' Furthermore, if he performs it, the angels remain with him. This is the significance of this night. If you consider the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) as your intercessor, Allah prepares Paradise for him. He prepares it for him, and until he leaves this world, he will see these things. This is the importance of a small act; therefore, consider every minute a blessing and keep performing good deeds. The best deed on this night is the Dua for the reappearance of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.). You know the Dua 'Allahumma kun li-waliyyikal Hujjatibnil Hasan...' is present in the books. It is explicitly written that you should recite it repeatedly—not just once or twice, but continuously. During the 23rd night, keep reciting it. Just as the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) used to do, and as the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) taught, recite it and ask for the forgiveness of all your sins. Do not be negligent; be alert. Start reciting it. If someone feels sleepy, sprinkle water on them to remove the sleepiness. This was the practice of Lady Fatima (s.a.)—she used to keep her children awake throughout the night by giving them less food so they would not fall into a deep sleep and could engage in worship. She would teach them the importance of this night. Pay attention to this. She used to say that whoever misses this night is deprived of Allah's mercy. Therefore, there is a strong tradition to stay awake all night and not sleep. This night determines the affairs of your entire life for the coming year—your sustenance, the time of your death, and all the changes that will occur in your life are written on this night. This night is so significant that even if one were to spend their entire life in worship, they could not reach the height of this night. A person's average lifespan is about 60-70 years. During this night, keep your sins in front of your eyes, remember them, and weep over them. If you do this, I am hopeful that you will not be disappointed, because when a person remains in a state of repentance, Allah increases his status. When a person remains in a state of repentance, Allah increases his status and grants him His grace. This is recorded in his account. Regarding the Quran, it was revealed in its entirety to Bayt al-Ma'mur on the fourth heaven, and from there, it was brought down to the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) over the course of his life. The Quran was revealed, and the disbelievers used to say, 'Do not listen to this Quran; make noise so that you may overcome them.' They knew the effect of the Quran. We have moved away from the Quran. The Prophet (s.a.w.a.) himself described this reality. The people of Mecca used to say, 'Do not listen to this Quran, make noise so that you do not get influenced by it.' They knew that if you listen to his words, you will be influenced. Therefore, they used to create a commotion because the speech of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) has a profound effect, just as the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) said: 'Recite our speech to the people, for if people know the beauty of our speech, they will follow us.' If these people knew the beauty of our speech, they would surely serve us. It is not that they do not listen, but it is brought for the children. And when we recite the songs of the beloved, it is Allah, and Allah embraced the Quran and the chapters were taught. And how it was taught, it was like the rotation of Sufi, Sufi, and the enemy's war was fought. As long as they were in the struggle, whatever money they kept for work, he would give it. He had done business with what he had, he was a designer in weapons, he was a balance center, and this new village had a lot of money. The new village had a lot of money. After that, when the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) migrated to Medina, all the wars that were fought with the companions, all those wars were financed by this person. He used to finance it in such a way that if the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) needed money, if people needed weapons, he would provide weapons for free. He was a man who, whenever there was a need, would fulfill it. And when the conquest happened, he came to the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) and knocked on the door. The Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) opened the door and asked, 'What has happened?' The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) said, 'Today you are forgiven.' He said, 'I cannot accept your words, your soul is...' Then he said, 'Do you believe in the words of Muhammad?' He said, 'I believe in the words of Muhammad because before his declaration of Islam, we used to call him Sadiq (the Truthful) and Amin (the Trustworthy).' Before, we used to call him Sadiq and Amin. We can reject him, but I believe in your words. You bring a message from Muhammad.' He went to him with the whole story. He saw how he was forgiven. He came and said, 'O Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.), this is what he gave.' He saw, and the onlookers said, 'Now you are saying the right thing.' And he accepted Islam at the hands of the Messenger. And he accepted Islam, not just for show, but he accepted Islam in reality. Once he accepted Islam, his Islam was such that he stayed with the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) as long as he was in this world. After that, his son, the son of Umayya, was the one who took revenge. He became a companion of the Master of the Universe (Ali a.s.) and stayed with the Master of the Universe until the very end, until his last breath. Now look here, this thing is seen, so he says that after that, the meaning of 'that' is that on the night of the 19th, the decree, on the night of the 19th, the night of decree, the decree is decided. To whom does it come? He does it, and he signs it. And after that, that thing proceeds. It is made for Allah; Allah can change the decree if He returns, but for that, a lot of hard work is required. So, the meaning of Qadr, the meaning of destiny, is that every thing comes to the decree. The angels and the spirit descend, and with them, the angels do the work of Allah in the time... Face to face, and for that, it should go to the city of good friends. But that man can do it... We are talking about a very big thing. Besides the Almighty, who else is there? That you are in the decree... and it is a matter of regret that many of our things and our... if we try, if this rule... This was an electronic production that... about the Surah, and look at the story of our Imam (a.s.). The Imam of Wilayah, this happened, whatever thing is subscribed, my name is... So, let's bring it to the Imam of the time. Let's see the traditions, we will try very quickly, and after that, God willing... Trying, and after that, the demise, and after you go, here this is for the Prophet, but in such matters, they say it correctly. And the Imam (a.s.) says from the Prophet, but to explain, these are good friends. That is why he says in the address that Allah and the Quran have not explained, and it is not said except that the Messenger is the one who calculates for you. But for others, the address is not for the Prophet, but for the whole... and after that, all this, we... That it is our duty, that 'Innallaha yuhibbu' (Indeed Allah loves)... Allah is very different. He chooses from His... Allah is Allah, the Quran is saying... And they entrust to them whatever they have written. They believe in all of it. In faith, the whole destiny is included. And in these twelve things, the angels and the messengers are included. As the verse has been revealed, it is written that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) was sitting, and the angels were sitting with him... That the authority is there, that this is that your status is back in its place, but this is the sky. The angels will be with you, yes, absolutely. And the angels, staying with the angels, how long is the greatness? So this was the status, the first object, no one got it, and we do the tawaf... Or perhaps they haven't found it, and they keep circling us for all the 'Ras Malai' (sweet treats/rewards). They circle us with hatred, saying, 'Positive, Sadar, the festival of Rasulullah (s.a.w.a.)...' May Allah remove the obstacles from your path. Thirdly, why, why, why? They reached these limits regarding Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.), and after him, in their narrations, this dispute is found in Bihar al-Anwar, where someone asked Imam Musa Kazim (a.s.) about the verse... ...regarding the verse 'Inna aradna al-amanata...' (Indeed, We offered the Trust...). You know that this is a reminder, what a powerful way it has been asked in this matter. I am saying, what does it feel like? 'Ala ma waradna al-amanata...' (We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth...). What is the meaning of this? It means that in Islam, Allah offered the 'Amanah' (Trust) to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains. If you compare this... ...if you compare this, the heavens and the earth were moved from here to there, and all the mountains were moved. After that, this verse was presented before them. It is Surah Al-Ahzab, verse number 72: 'Inna aradna al-amanata 'ala al-samawati wal-ardi wal-jibal, fa-abayna an yahmilnaha wa ashfaqna minha, wa hamalaha al-insan...' (Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it). Whoever usurped Ali's right, he took it upon himself. And Allah... ...and he took it upon himself, and all the interpretations you will find, they are all the same. This is what you discussed—that this 'Amanah' is what is found in the traditions. It is said that man is 'Zaluman Jahula' (unjust and ignorant). So what is the interpretation? Anyway, the interpretation of this verse, you should be happy about this; it is a matter of pride for us. ...and if you have done this to take revenge for the killing of Ali's father, then it is rejected. 'Wa man lam yu'min billahi wa rasulihi...' (And whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger...). As we explained, as we have done, for him is the punishment. And for those who falsely accuse us, may the curse of Allah and the angels be upon the killer, upon the oppressor. ...upon the killer, upon the oppressor. This matter came up four, five, seven times. On that, there is a strong stance. How will it be affected? For him, for him, it is as if we have brought up a trivial matter. There is no importance in this, there is no weight in this talk, because he will not tolerate it at all. Even if he says, 'Why?', because there is no weight in this talk, because you see that some things were present in the understanding, but... ...but when it is there, it is written in my book, meaning if some great doctor or engineer is there, they haven't asked for it, but no one has it. But no one has it. Go, come back like this, 'Wa law...' And if he says this, 'Qul, la...' ...'Qul, la...'. It is a very long, very difficult matter. And after that, the second point is that this is also a tradition, that in 'Tafsir al-Safi', page 249, it is mentioned that Imam Baqir (a.s.) says, 'O such and such, why is it like this? Our enemies, from the hands of the oppressors...' Look, debate with our opponents, argue with them. And who are these? Today's news... so do not make them ineffective at all, do not give them a complaint. By Allah, this is the limit, because this 'Surah' is the proof of Allah over all of Allah's creation after Rasulullah (s.a.w.a.). ...and this Surah is the master of this entire religion. It is so important, that is why its importance is... 'Wa inna...' and this is the limit of our religion. We cannot do it, we cannot do it. Some people cannot understand even a minor thing. They don't understand 'Halal' and 'Haram', so this is a very big thing. People don't understand small things; this is a very big matter. Regarding the status of the Surah, I am opening it before you. ...open it, remind them. Who do they come to? After this, they believe in the Imam. 'Ha-Mim. Wal-kitabil-mubin. Inna anzalnahu fi laylatin mubarakah...' (Ha-Mim. By the clear Book. Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night). This is the first verse of the entire Quran, and the second is... I swear by my mother, they don't take the name, they don't bless it. Indeed, the blessed night is the 19th, 21st, 23rd... 'Baytul Ma'mur', they are the ones who are guilty, and indeed, we are not the ones to be afraid. Remember, there is no ambiguity in this, so diplomacy does not work here. It does not mean that... It is not about sweet talk; there is no such thing as me inviting girls at the age of three. This 'La ilaha illallah'—that there is no god but Allah—is what has been prepared. End all of this. If you adopt this, you will succeed. Stay away from all these issues, leave everything behind. This company, this work we do—let's compromise a little, you give a little, we give a little, you move forward a little, we move back a little—this diplomacy is the world's political world, a world of selfishness, a world of deceit. That is why when the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) used to do... When he used to do it, the Giver, the Doer... I would tell who I am, that I tell him this. We come, and the Messenger of Allah's... you do this, and for this, it has been appointed. It is the Imam's companions who fulfilled it. Read, and read this carefully. In these hadiths, there is true guidance. That is why if you want to know all these things, then see how much they know. If you want to know, then see how much they know. Allahu Akbar. We come to the things... O Messenger, Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala... and if there is anyone... Yes, this is very... in the traditions, there are things happening every day. Yes, in the gathering, the end is happening... I will tell you. 'Inna Allah wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'alan-nabi' (Verily, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet). Allah is saying, 'Muhammad, My angels and I are your friends, peace be upon you. Peace, my peace, peace is the name of Allah.' Peace, my peace, peace is the name of Allah, they are bringing it. The angels who are coming, they are bringing it. This is for the one who is ill, for the one who is suffering; this is the peace they send to you. In the past, they used to send peace, and for two minutes, keep this in mind... that this is the status, the honor, that 'Inna lahum ma'sumin' (Verily, they are infallible). We know that. For the sake of the Imam, first remember your Imam. He is the most oppressed. Your Imam is the most oppressed. He is oppressed by every era. Now is not the time to discuss the world of the Imam. Why? Because Allah is the Helper. Do not doubt. There are many traditions; gather them and pray. And I am showing you this—this is the path of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. So, this is the prayer for the Imam of the time, may Allah protect him in every way, may Allah keep him safe. Thank you very much, sir. Thank you very much, sir, that you mentioned the patients in your speech, especially regarding this month and regarding the Imam. It is hoped that the believers will act upon this. We are now moving towards the recitation of Dua Abu Hamza al-Thumali. I request the reciters to keep their copies of the supplication with them. Whoever has the 'Mafatih al-Jinan', in the section of the blessed month of Ramadan, you will find this supplication there. Besides this, there are separate books for this supplication. Keep that book with you. If you do not have the book, then in the 'Divine Forces' app, you will also find this supplication in our section for the blessed month of Ramadan. So keep it ready. We will move towards this supplication, but before that, a brief two-three minute introduction about this supplication and about Imam's companion, Abu Hamza al-Thumali, is to be presented here. Abu Hamza al-Thumali's full name was Thabit bin Dinar, and he was a resident of Kufa, and it is found in these books... He was a resident of Kufa, and it is found in these books that he was... they called him the 'Fatah' (conqueror) of Kufa. He was one of the scholars of his time and was known among the Imams. Abu Hamza al-Thumali had permission to debate; he used to debate with the enemies, the opponents, and he used to argue regarding the Imamate. And he had special permission from the Imams. Besides this, his greatness and his status can be judged by the fact that the Imams (a.s.) themselves said about him. For example, the fourth Imam (a.s.) said to him, 'O Abu Hamza, when I see you, I feel relief.' This is such a strange sentence that the Imam said for Abu Hamza. The Imam says, 'O Abu Hamza, when I see you, I feel relief.' This is to say that when I see you, I do not see myself at that station... he was among the companions of the Imam. The point is that tonight, on the Night of Qadr... The point is that tonight, regarding the Night of Qadr, we all pray that we too can reach this station and level through our prayers, through our knowledge, through our recognition, and through Wilayah, so that the Imam of our time can also say to us, 'When I see you, I feel relief.' Besides this, this tradition is present, and Allama Hilli, in the book 'Rijal' he wrote, this tradition is present from the Imam (a.s.). The Imam says, 'Abu Hamza al-Thumali in his time was like Luqman in his time.' We all know the status of Luqman, that Allah made his advice into verses of the Quran. And then the Imams say... why was this? Because Abu Hamza had this status, this level. He served four Imams. This itself makes his status and his level clear. He served four Imams: the fourth, fifth, sixth, and some time of the seventh Imam. He was the blessed person of the seventh Imam. He spent some time in the era of the seventh Imam, and he passed away in the time of the seventh Imam. And the last thing, regarding Abu Hamza al-Thumali, his greatness and nobility can be judged by the fact that the Imam taught such a great supplication to Abu Hamza. This supplication of Abu Hamza al-Thumali... we all read Dua Kumayl every week, which the Imam taught to Kumayl. From that, the status of Kumayl is known. So, one can imagine what the status of Abu Hamza al-Thumali would be, what his position would be, that such an important supplication... you are well aware of its importance. We will read it, Insha'Allah. The fourth Imam, in this blessed month of Ramadan, in every night, before the dawn, in the last part of the night, used to recite this supplication. It is filled with knowledge and wisdom. The Imam chose Abu Hamza al-Thumali for the recitation of this supplication. So, we move towards that supplication. I request the reciters to begin the recitation of the supplication. Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa ali Muhammad. Salawat... Keep it ready, and Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad. O Allah, I seek refuge in You... until the breath breaks... O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord... a son is coming... what is the command... O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah. Alhamdulillah, Alhamdulillah, Alhamdulillah. Allahu Jalla Jalaluhu... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... He has kept the doors open for those who come to Him, even if they come having committed sins. Even if they come having committed sins, O my brother... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... Allah is the One who is the Truth, there is no god but He. [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... O Master, O Allah, we ask of You... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... You have purified the heart, do not let it be separated or ruined. [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... When the time of prayer comes, remember Allah... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... [Music]... O Allah, grant us the strength to follow the path of the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his Ahlulbayt (a.s.). O Allah, grant us the strength... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... What a great matter this is, O Master of the Universe... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... We thank You for the blessings You have bestowed upon our homes, and for the sins and faults You have covered and hidden from others. [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... I will remain at Your door, I will keep calling upon You, because I have heard such beautiful things about You. [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... O Lord, O Merciful, O Compassionate... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... And they were praying to You, hoping that You would accept their prayers. [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... He was showing love, and we were there... As far as the workshop is concerned... [Recitation of Arabic phrases]... We seek the intercession of the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his family (a.s.). Allah, Allah, Allah... Allah, Allah, Allah, may Allah grant us the understanding of Muhammad (s.a.w.a.)... O Lord of the Worlds, grant us the ability, grant us the strength to follow the path of those who have attained victory. When it comes before me, my steps falter. I cannot enter, for the weight of my sins wounds me. O Lord, how many times have I turned away, yet You have always brought me back to Your threshold. Before all of this, everything was clear. Now, I am hesitant, wondering if I should go or stay. I am hesitant, wondering if I should go or stay. In all these moments, remembering the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) is my only solace. You have done everything for me, even when I was nothing. I did not care about the opinions of others. I was surrounded by my own ego, thinking no one would object to me. But when I stood before You, O Lord, I realized the truth of my actions and sought Your help. Your mercy is the only way. If Your mercy does not guide me, then there is no hope. I seek refuge in 'La ilaha illallah' (There is no god but Allah) and the love of Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and his family. O Lord, remove the love of this world from my heart. Let me speak only of the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and his family. My life is dedicated to them. I do not seek anything else; I only seek the love of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.). That is my only desire and my only refuge. I carry Your remembrance in my heart. Even if I am weak, I stand before You, seeking Your mercy and protection from the trials of this life. Do not let the fire of Hell burn me, for I hold onto Your love. You are my only hope, and in You, I place my trust for the life to come. Just imagine, when I am laid in this grave, when they leave, I will be all alone. In that house, in that solitude, have mercy on me, for I do not recognize anyone there. [Arabic/Transliteration: Ya Allah, have mercy on me in my loneliness...] If you leave the world, then you are alone. O Lord, I am knocking at Your door. Through Your favors, I seek refuge. [Arabic/Transliteration: Ya Allah...] [Arabic/Transliteration: ...Rasul (s.a.w.a.)...] [Arabic/Transliteration: ...O my God, I swear by Your honor, I swear by Your majesty, if You punish me, I will tell Your beloved (the Prophet)...] If You punish me, Your enemies will be happy. And if You admit me into Paradise, it will be a source of joy for Your Prophet. [Arabic/Transliteration: ...Ya Rasul Allah...] [Arabic/Transliteration: ...Allahumma Labbayk, Allahumma Amin, the Book of Allah...] Labbayk Allahumma Amin. The Book of Allah says: whoever has done us a favor, forgive them. And as for those of us who have been negligent in Your rights, forgive us. [Arabic/Transliteration: ...] [Arabic/Transliteration: ...O Allah... We are very grateful to the Doctor and...] We are very grateful to the Doctor for joining us in this program. We all pray that in these final moments, for the sake of Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, may Allah grant us the ability to act upon his teachings and grant us relief from this calamity soon, so that we may gather again. Our final prayer is praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his progeny.

title: Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) Hazrat Fatima (s.a.) Ki Nasl Se Hain - Sunni Kitaab Se Daleel
excerpt: This lecture highlights authentic Sunni traditions confirming the lineage of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.). It specifically references Sunan Ibn Majah, one of the six canonical Hadith collections, to establish that the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) explicitly identified Imam Mahdi as a descendant of Hazrat Fatima (s.a.). The discussion emphasizes the consensus regarding his belonging to the Ahlulbayt.
content:
The famous and well-known book named Sunan Ibn Majah, which is also counted among the Sihah al-Sittah (the six authentic books of Hadith). In this book, a Hadith is found from the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) where he says: 'Al-Mahdi is from the progeny of Fatimah (s.a.).' Similarly, there is another reference in the same book where the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) says: 'Mahdi is from us,' meaning from the Ahlulbayt.

title: EP05 | Difaa-e-Ghadeer: Kab, Kahan Aur Kisne Ki? | 💐 GHADEER: PAYMAAN-E-ILAAHI MEGA QUIZ 💐
excerpt: This lecture, part of the 'Ghadeer: Paymaan-e-Ilaahi' mega quiz series, explores the historical and theological significance of the event of Ghadir Khumm. It emphasizes the divine command to proclaim the Wilayah of Imam Ali (a.s.) and highlights the continuous defense of this truth by the Prophet, Janabe Zahra, and the Imams. The session also provides educational insights into scholarly defenses of Ghadir and outlines the requirements for participants in the ongoing mega quiz competition.
content:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan, in the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. And blessings be upon you, O Wali al-Asr, help us and do not let us perish. Respected and honorable listeners and viewers, peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Ya Ali Madad. We are back once again to serve you with another episode of Ghadir Paimana-e-Ilahi, and we welcome you all to this episode. Come, respected viewers, let us begin today's episode with these lines: Paradise is but the fruit of Ali's love, yet you still find it bad, Ya Ali Madad. Paradise is but the fruit of Ali's love, yet you still find it bad, Ya Ali Madad. Your expression changed over such a small matter, your expression changed over such a small matter, I only said, Ya Ali Madad. In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. O Allah, be for Your Wali, the Proof, son of Hassan, Your blessings be upon him and his forefathers, in this hour and in every hour, a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and an eye, until You make him reside in Your earth in obedience and let him enjoy it for a long time. Respected viewers, first of all, let us tell you a few things about the Ghadir Paimana-e-Ilahi Mega Quiz. There will be seven episodes, and in each episode, a discussion regarding Ghadir and the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) will be presented to you, and the quiz questions will be based on this discussion. In each episode, there will be seven lucky winners who will be selected through our computerized lucky draw system. The first prize is 5,000, the second two prizes are 3,000 each, and the third four prizes are 1,000 each. And finally, our Ghadir Paimana-e-Ilahi Mega Quiz mega prize is the one that every lover of Ali (a.s.) desires in their heart, that they want to go to their Mawla's threshold and bow their head in submission, that is, Ziyarat of Iraq. Yes, viewers, the mega prize is for the Ziyarat of Iraq, which will be announced in a special episode after this series ends. To be eligible for the mega prize of Ziyarat of Iraq, one must watch all these episodes, i.e., all seven episodes, and participate in the quiz of each episode. Out of the seven episodes, you must give correct answers to all questions in at least five episodes' quizzes. From all such individuals, the winner of our mega prize, i.e., the Ziyarat of Iraq, will be selected through our computerized lucky draw system. We hope that you will stay with us throughout this series and keep participating in every quiz. The quiz link will be activated as soon as each episode starts, and the quiz link is available in the live chat and description of this video. At the end of each episode, there will be Ziyarat Aminullah. As soon as the Ziyarat ends, the seven lucky winners of the episode will be announced through our computerized lucky draw system. We request you to listen to our episodes carefully and give correct answers to all the questions. Respected viewers, the announcement of Ghadir is an announcement of such importance and status in Islamic history that we have been describing its importance in our previous episodes. What is the importance of Ghadir, and what is the importance of the Caliphate and Imamate for which the announcement of Ghadir was made? All these things were presented before you. At the same time, where the announcement of Ghadir has such importance, attempts were made to hide it very intensely and erase it from Islamic history. But if its opponents try to hide it, it was also clarified in the same way. For example, if we think, if any name comes to the fore in the defense of Ghadir, it is that of Allah Almighty Himself. When the first opponent came forward after the announcement of Ghadir and denied this announcement, the Wilayah and Imamate of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) which the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) announced in Ghadir, the first one who defended this announcement was Allah Almighty, who immediately sent punishment upon him through a stone, and that incident was such that after that, no Muslim in the history of the Islamic world dared to be seen making a curse like Harith ibn Nu'man. But when this fear settled in the hearts of the opponents and hypocrites, what did they do? They started objecting. But it is not that these objections were not answered. Those believers in whose hearts the candle of Ghadir was lit, those in whose hearts the love of Amir al-Mu'minin was strong, they always came forward and gave such a befitting reply to the opponents of the Ghadir announcement, and they have been giving it, and God willing, they will continue to do so until the reappearance of Imam-e-Zamana (a.s.). And our discussion today is also on this topic, that we have to present a brief discussion before you regarding the defense of Ghadir. But before starting the discussion, the date today is one of the sacrifices and martyrdoms presented in this defense of Ghadir, which is the martyrdom of the sons of Janab Muslim ibn Aqil (a.s.). So, first of all, let us offer condolences for this martyrdom in the court of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.), especially in the court of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.), and we also offer our condolences to you all. And let us begin today's episode. To discuss the defense of Ghadir, our brothers Janab Shabih al-Hassan Sahib and Janab Kazim Syed Sahib are present in our gathering. Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah. And peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Kazim Bhai, we would like to start today's discussion with you. As our topic today is the defense of Ghadir, we would like you to shed light on how, after the incident of Ghadir, if people tried to object to this incident and point fingers in different ways, we want you to present this clarification before our viewers, how this incident was defended so that despite so much opposition, this incident is still so bright. Zafar Bhai, as you just said that this incident is bright, and indeed it is as bright as the sun. Indeed. And today is also the night of martyrdom, the hearts of all believers... are wounded that today two small children of Zahra's family were martyred. Coming to our topic, Gulzar Bhai, that indeed the incident of Ghadir is as bright as the sun, but it is a matter of regret that Muslims have forgotten it. As you said in your statement, Gulzar Bhai, the defense of Ghadir was started by Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala Himself in the field of Ghadir and strengthened the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin. Let us also present some things before you, before our viewers, and tell the viewers how the Imams (a.s.) defended Ghadir. But before that, there are a few things to present before you and the viewers, that the famous and well-known verse of the incident of Ghadir, which is famous by the name of Ayah-e-Tabligh, in it, the command of the Lord of Honor is being given: “O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, and if you do not, then you have not conveyed His message. And Allah will protect you from the people.” Now, if I talk a little bit about this, we keep hearing its statement in our gatherings and assemblies from our scholars and Zakireen about its initial and middle parts. I only want to draw your attention and the attention of our viewers to the last part. Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala is pointing towards this fact that “Wallahu ya'simuka minan-nas.” Now here, the Muslim Ummah needs to ponder why Allah used this sentence? Although there should be no condition or secret in the command of the Almighty. It was a gathering of conspiracies. It was a gathering of conspiracies, and Allah's use of this sentence is an indication that there was a possibility of some such things happening there, or there was some background to it, based on which Allah Almighty revealed this sentence in this verse. Either some wicked people were present there, or mischief was about to happen, or later. Yes, so the background of this is that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) had this scene in front of his eyes that some such people were present there, or in front of his eyes, there was a scarcity of believers and the Messenger of Allah was feeling the abundance of hypocrites there. Yes. And for this reason, it is possible, for this reason, Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala used the sentence “Wallahu ya'simuka minan-nas” that O Messenger, convey the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin and do not be afraid. Allah will keep you safe from the evil of these people. And you see that from Ashir to Ghadir, the Messenger of Allah has been continuously announcing the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin, and at the final stage of his life, when the Messenger of Allah is reaching, there too, the Messenger of Allah had somewhere in his mind that if I make this announcement, this Muslim Ummah will turn away from the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin. Yes. And even after emphasizing so much, this Muslim Ummah will not accept the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin. Yes. In this regard, the statement of our and your Imam, Imam Kazim (a.s.), Allama Muhammad Baqir Majlisi brings this in Bihar al-Anwar, he brings this Hadith in which the Imam (a.s.) says: “Allah has not emphasized anything to the servants as much as the acknowledgment of Imamate.” Meaning, Allah has emphasized the Wilayah and Imamate of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) through His beloved, through His Messenger, more than anything else. But after that, listen to the Imam's words, what the Imam is saying. The Imam is saying: “And the servants have not denied anything as much as they have denied this.” Meaning, people have abandoned it or did not acknowledge the Imamate and Wilayah. Meaning, the more emphasis there was, the more people turned away from it. So, the Messenger of Allah had this scene in front of his eyes that if I announce the Wilayah, this Muslim Ummah will turn away. So it was not that the Messenger of Allah was afraid for his life or was not announcing for any other reason. The hesitation the Messenger of Allah had in the announcement was only regarding this, that the Muslim Ummah might turn away. And this command was not only for Ghadir, or for the Messenger of Allah, but it is for all the Muslim Ummah, especially those who claim to love the Messenger of Allah, that they should announce the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin in every aspect of their lives. Yes. The Messenger of Allah announced it, and you see the martyrdom of the Messenger of Allah happened two months later. Okay? So the Messenger of Allah did not fear for his life, did not fear for his life, and even after that, he conveyed the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin to the people. In the same way, we too must continue to convey the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin to the people without any fear, without being afraid, and this is “Wallahu ya'simuka minan-nas” that Allah will protect the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin. Allah will never let this light be extinguished. Indeed. This is our most important responsibility that we convey the message of Ghadir. Okay? And not just on the day of Ghadir, we should keep presenting the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin to the people and before the world throughout the year. Indeed. And what a beautiful thing the poet said, this couplet of Janab Hilal Naqvi Sahib is coming to my mind, that we will keep increasing the flame of this lamp. Yes. That we will keep increasing the flame of this lamp, we do not like any decrease in the love of Ali. Wow! Subhan Allah. We do not like any decrease in the love of Ali. And it is not that only here the verse of Ghadir, this Ayah-e-Tabligh, is attributed to Amir al-Mu'minin, but in the books of Ahl-e-Tasannun also, this verse is attributed to Amir al-Mu'minin, and in the very famous and well-known book Tafsir-e-Durr al-Manthur, Jalaluddin Suyuti has narrated that Ibn Mas'ud says that when we used to recite this verse in the time of the Messenger of Allah, we used to recite it in this way: “O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, that Ali is the Mawla of the believers.” Subhan Allah. That O Messenger, convey what has been revealed from your Lord of the Worlds. Indeed, Ali (a.s.) is the Mawla of the believers. Subhan Allah. Meaning, this narration is found in Durr al-Manthur that those people used to recite it in that way in that time. Yes, yes, yes, yes. Yes, yes. That O Messenger, you convey that Ali is the Mawla of the believers. Yes. Truly, it is a surprise for the Muslim Ummah. Moving forward in our discussion, the discussion about the defense of Ghadir is going on, as Kazim Bhai was saying that the Messenger of Allah made the announcement, so Allah is taking his guarantee that O Messenger, we are here to protect you from the wicked people who will spread mischief. So after that, it is also certain that people also had malice towards the Messenger of Allah regarding the Mawla of the Universe, meaning, as the incident is found that the Messenger of Allah asked for paper and pen to write the Wilayah, to write his will, then people refused. So the expression of people's malice towards the Messenger of Allah was also coming to the fore. Yes. So what must have happened after the Messenger? When the Messenger is there, people's expression before him is like this, then what must have been the attitude of people regarding Ghadir or regarding the Wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.)? I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. The biggest tragedy of Islam is that immediately after the martyrdom of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.), when the Muslims chose someone against Ali in Saqifah, then after that, the biggest problem before them was how to take allegiance from the family of the Messenger. Because they were sure that if Ali does not give allegiance, then their claim to the Caliphate is false. These people repeatedly demanded from Mawla Ali that you come and give us allegiance, and Mawla Ali completely rejected the allegiance that I will not do it. Yes. After that, these people made a plan and a few individuals came to the door of Janabe Zahra (s.a.) with wood and they called out to the daughter of the Messenger to send Ali out. When Janabe Zahra (s.a.) refused, they bluntly threatened the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, the Sayyidatun Nisa-il-Alamin (Leader of the women of the worlds), the leader of the women in Paradise. They threatened her that if you do not bring Ali out, we will not even consider who is present inside this house. And look who was present? The Mawla-e-Kainat (Master of the Universe) himself was present, Janabe Zahra (s.a.) was present inside that house, Janabe Hasanain, Imam Hasan (a.s.), and Imam Hussain (a.s.) were present. But they did not even respect this. And they claimed that if you do not bring Ali out, we will set the house on fire. Janabe Zahra (s.a.) even asked, 'Do you realize who is here? Who is in this house?' They said, 'It makes no difference to me who is in the house.' And when Janabe Zahra (s.a.) refused to hand over Mawla Ali (a.s.) to them, they forcibly entered the house, burned wood at the door, and Janabe Zahra (s.a.) came between the wall and the door. The first martyr in Islam in the defense of Wilayat-e-Ghadir was Janabe Mohsin ibn Ali (a.s.). This is absolutely clear. From that time, the martyrdom of Janabe Mohsin (a.s.) and the way Janabe Zahra (s.a.) defended the Wilayat of Ali (a.s.) immediately after the passing of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.), from that time until today, whenever a voice has been raised in defense of Ghadir, every effort has been made to suppress that voice. And in this, not only the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) but the companions of the Ahlulbayt, our scholars, and all our Shia have offered sacrifices of their lives, honor, and wealth. Indeed. Indeed. And Gulzar Bhai, as Shabih-ul-Hasan Sahab has just presented this before the viewers, the first martyr regarding Ghadir is Janabe Mohsin ibn Ali (a.s.). In the same way, Janabe Zahra (s.a.) is the first person in the family of the Ahlulbayt (a.s.) who raised her voice and protested in defense of Ghadir. Indeed. Indeed. When people come to Janabe Zahra (s.a.) and say this sentence—these sentences are present in 'Dalail al-Imamah'—please clarify what these sentences are. That 'Ya Sayyidatan Nisa'—O Sayyida, the people are saying this, right? People are saying to Janabe Zahra (s.a.), 'O Princess, O Sayyida, if Abul Hasan (a.s.) had spoken to us regarding this matter'—meaning regarding the Caliphate—'if Amirul Momineen (a.s.) had come to us and spoken, and reminded the people before this contract took place'—meaning before the allegiance to the first Caliph—'then none of us would have gone astray.' Meaning, they are trying to say that if Amirul Momineen (a.s.) had come earlier or if you had come earlier and alerted us regarding this matter, we would have pledged allegiance to Amirul Momineen (a.s.). We would not have gone there to pledge allegiance to so-and-so. They are saying this, they are presenting this excuse. Now, here, Janabe Zahra (s.a.) uses Ghadir to counter their statement in defense of Ghadir. Yes. She states, 'Fama ja'allahu li-ahadin ba'da Ghadiri Khummin min hujjatin bila uzr'—She states that Allah will not accept any excuse or argument from you people after Ghadir-e-Khum. Meaning, after the announcement made at Ghadir-e-Khum, no excuse remains, no argument remains for you to say that if Amirul Momineen (a.s.) had come to us, we would have pledged allegiance to him, or if you had come. Although they were lying. If you look at history books, our books and even the books of the Ahl-e-Sunnah, it is found in both schools of thought that Janabe Zahra (s.a.) took Amirul Momineen (a.s.) and went to everyone's door and reminded them that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) had chosen Amirul Momineen (a.s.) as your Mawla at Ghadir-e-Khum. So they were lying here. Indeed. But regarding Ghadir, Janabe Sayyida (s.a.) said that Allah will not accept your excuse. How many days had passed since that event of Ghadir? It was necessary to remind two people. Two months and a few days had passed. It was a lie by the people. You said it absolutely correctly, Kazim Sahab. But the point to observe is also that two months and a few days had passed. My father's Wilayat was ignored, and then the final sentence of this sermon, the last sentence regarding Ghadir in the sermon, was when she asked, 'Did this nation not hear my grandfather say: Falyuballighish-shahidu-l-ghaib—it is obligatory for every present person to convey this news to the absent?' And this is not just for the people of that time, but for people of every era, that they should spread this news, this Ghadir, this announcement of Wilayat to every corner of the world, especially among their children and all the Shia brethren. And its right—although the right cannot be fulfilled—but in the way we celebrate other Eids, we should express this message with much more intensity through this Eid-e-Eidullah or this Eid-e-Akbar, as it is called. And it should be discussed throughout all the months of the year.
